text: Salah Qaid bin Qaid is chairman of the board of Saudia Alqaid Transport Co (Saudi Qaid Transport Company).
short: Saudi Qaid Transport is chaired by Salah Qaid bin Qaid.

source.name: Hajj & Umrah Forum – participant profile of Salah Qaid bin Qaid
source.quote: صلاح قايد بن قايد رئيس مجلس الادارة Saudia Alqaid Transport Co.
source.note: Translation: 'Salah Qaid bin Qaid, chairman of the board, Saudia Alqaid Transport Co.' Participant profile on the official Hajj & Umrah Forum platform (event 8–11 January 2024).
